brief:
为 Davidoff Cool Water 制作高品质商业香水海报。保留上传商品原貌与可见标签；为这款商品形成四个真正不同的创意方向。只使用品牌与产品名称，不添加价格、容量、促销、新品或功效宣传。
本次必须采用以下独立艺术方向，优先于通用风格要求；保留用户商品、文案和禁止事项：Cool Water as a single ping on a nautical chart: a flat matte glacier-mint card carries fine concentric sonar rings in deep marine teal expanding from the exact centre of the frame, one thicker hard-edge ring marking the return echo. The upright blue slab stands centred in the lower two-thirds as the source of the ping, its baked backlight glow untouched by the flat ink world. All type stacks in a calm centred monument band at the top: wide-tracked Bodoni brand line, the name in one generous Didone line, the eau de toilette line closing the stack, with a short teal rule floating beneath like a chart tick. No floor, no horizon - pure radial echo geometry against translucent ocean glass.

references.selection_reason: Highly resolved minimalist still-life featuring strong caustic light play and organic prop styling; excellent reference for aquatic fragrance campaigns despite lacking external campaign typography.

analysis.composition: Asymmetrical top-down flat lay balancing the geometric bottle on the left with sweeping organic branch lines on the right, anchored by a strong diagonal shadow.
analysis.negative_space: Expansive, clean off-white background dominating the frame to emphasize light effects and negative space.
analysis.lighting: Hard, direct sunlight creating sharp cast shadows and vibrant, colorful caustic refractions through the blue glass.
analysis.typography: None visible outside the container; text is strictly limited to the product label.
analysis.information_density: Very low; focuses entirely on material, light, and form.

references.selection_reason: Highly resolved digital still-life featuring a clear perfume subject with strong geometric background elements and cohesive amber palette; excellent reference for tech-forward fragrance visuals.

analysis.composition: Centered rectangular bottle framed by large, soft-focus circular gradients creating depth and focus.
analysis.negative_space: Dark, gradient periphery focusing attention on the illuminated center.
analysis.lighting: Backlit and internal glow emphasizing liquid color and glass transparency against a dark void.
analysis.typography: None outside the container; label text is part of the product packaging.
analysis.information_density: Low; purely visual focus on product and abstract atmosphere.

references.selection_reason: Professionally resolved perfume still-life with high-end lighting and material detail, suitable as a design reference for luxury fragrance campaigns.

analysis.composition: Centered single-subject composition on a reflective surface against a gradient backdrop.
analysis.negative_space: Ample negative space above and around the bottle, filled with a smooth golden gradient.
analysis.lighting: Soft, diffused studio lighting creating specular highlights on the glass edges and metallic cap, with a clear reflection below.
analysis.typography: None. Text is limited to the brand label printed directly on the glass container.
analysis.information_density: Low, focusing entirely on the product form and material.
